item.title: The price of storage and inflating game install sizes like GTA 6 is going to mean some gamers are stuck on games
item.author: invalid@example.com (RedbullCola)
item.dc:creator: RedbullCola
item.content:encoded: The Xbox Series S has 364 GB of usable space. GTA 6 is 212 GB. CoD Modern Warfare 4 is 191gb with multiplayer, so you're out of space before you even get to CoD. Yes, there's consoles with more space - but often not much more. The whole point of consoles originally was because people who couldn't afford or didn't want a PC could get an affordable device to pick up and play games easily. It's a doorway to gaming for new generations of people. But the device isn't really affordable now... Read more

item.title: Best implementation of enemy infighting (both within a faction and between factions) and enemy friendly-fire in games
item.author: invalid@example.com (Spring-Loaded)
item.dc:creator: Spring-Loaded
item.content:encoded: Something that I always lament the absence of in games is enemies being able to affect or damage one another. When there's an AoE attack from an enemy that leaves its allies unscathed is always at least a little deflating, even if the game feels balanced around it overall. But when enemies can accidentally hit each other, or will turn on one another when their objectives are disrupted or they damage each other, that helps shoot the immersiveness of a game into the stratosphere, where I...
